BiblicalUsage: Nod is wandering, or exile, the word David uses in Psalm 56:8 when he says, Thou tellest my wanderings. It is the same root as the land of Nod, and here it is a man's own unsettled life, counted by God tear by tear.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God keeps count of every wandering, and no exile of His people escapes His book.
